card.name: The letter h starting a word after non-
card.fires_on: The lone letter h (or -h) that begins a word right after a hyphen or prefix, most often in non-hormonal contraception advice. Also fires on a capital H starting a word such as Hellenization or Hertfordshire.

modes.label: non-hormonal
modes.description: The h that starts hormonal right after non in contraception advice.
modes.example: use an effective alternative non<<-h>>ormonal form of contraception or additional contraceptive

modes.label: Other word-initial H
modes.description: A separate h or H that begins a word in general prose, such as after the.
modes.example: In my previous lecture I expressed my admiration for the work of the Church Fathers in the<< H>>ellenization of Christianity.
